newsitem.title: USA: Wachovia to buy Jefferson Bankshares for $542 mln.
newsitem.headline: Wachovia to buy Jefferson Bankshares for $542 mln.

text.p: Wachovia Corp. has signed a definitive agreement to buy Jefferson Bankshares Inc. in a deal valued at about $542 million, or $38.83 a share, the companies said Tuesday.
The agreement between Wachovia and the parent of Jefferson National Bank of Charlottesville, Va., has been approved by the boards of directors of both companies.
The deal is expected to close by Oct. 31, subject to the approval of Jefferson Bankshares shareholders and regulators.

The companies said the agreement provides for a tax-free exchange of 0.625 share of Winston-Salem, N.C.-based Wachovia common stock for each Jefferson Bankshares share. It will be accounted for as a purchase.
Based on Wachovia's June 9 closing stock price, the deal would be worth about $38.83 per share, or a total of $542 million, based on Jefferson Bankshares 13.95 million common shares outstanding.
Wachovia has an option to acquire about 19.9 percent of Jefferson's outstanding shares if the deal does not close under certain circumstances.
The merger is expected to have a positive impact on Wachovia's earnings in 1998, it said.
